name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Phantom Trace Spoofer
product_name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Phantom Trace Spoofer
description:
The Phantom Trace Spoofer is a compact identity-broadcasting device that simultaneously suppresses the user's genuine electronic identity emissions and substitutes a continuously rotating library of synthetic identities drawn from Arcturus Defense Solutions' proprietary ghost-profile database. The device intercepts signals from the user's personal electronics, embedded identification chips, transit tokens, and biometric broadcast systems, wrapping them in a spoofed identity layer that presents as a convincingly ordinary civilian or service worker to automated scanning infrastructure — access nodes, transit checkpoints, commercial facial recognition systems, and corporate perimeter sensors.

What sets the Phantom Trace Spoofer apart from simpler RFID blockers or identity jammers is its active emission strategy: rather than creating a detectable dead zone where a person's identity should be, it populates that space with a ghost profile that behaves like a real person — complete with synthetic movement history, a plausible employment record stub, and timed identity-rotation that mimics the normal pattern of a worker moving through multiple scan zones. The ghost-profile database receives over-the-air updates through an encrypted Arcturus channel, keeping synthetic identities ahead of blacklist databases. The device also includes a panic-wipe mode that erases operational profiles in under two seconds if the unit is at risk of capture.

Arcturus Defense Solutions markets the Phantom Trace Spoofer exclusively through defense and law enforcement procurement channels, making it officially unavailable to civilian or corporate buyers. In practice, a thriving secondary market exists, fed primarily by equipment recovered from Arcturus field teams and through a small number of internal procurement leaks. Ownership outside of authorized channels is a serious criminal offense in all six of GLMZ's administrative sectors, a fact that has done little to suppress demand.
base_technologies: Multi-protocol intercept layer (RFID, NFC, biometric broadcast, transit token)

specifications.identity_protocols_covered: RFID (125 kHz–13.56 MHz), NFC, standard biometric broadcast (GLMZ civil ID spec), corporate access token formats (12 of 14 major vendors)
specifications.ghost_profile_library: Rolling 72-hour library, 400+ active profiles per update cycle
specifications.database_update_frequency: Every 6 hours via encrypted Arcturus channel (requires network access)
specifications.detection_risk: Low against Tier 1–2 scanning infrastructure; Moderate against Tier 3 adaptive systems; High against Arcturus-manufactured scanning hardware

tactical_use: Worn concealed on the body or integrated into a jacket lining. Activated before entering scan-heavy zones such as corporate campuses, transit hubs, or monitored commercial districts. Operatives typically set identity rotation to the 20-minute interval for urban movement and switch to manual rotation during static infiltration phases to avoid triggering anomaly detection from a single identity appearing in multiple scan zones. The device is notably less effective against Arcturus's own scanning infrastructure, which carries a known ghost-profile recognition layer — a fact that Arcturus does not publicize.
cultural_context: In GLMZ, the Phantom Trace Spoofer is something of a mythologized object — its prohibited status and Arcturus pedigree give it a prestige that operatives at every level aspire to. Owning one signals either genuine connections to defense-sector channels or the resources to pay black-market prices. The device has also become a point of political contention: civil liberties groups cite its existence as evidence that Arcturus Defense Solutions has built a surveillance infrastructure specifically designed to be defeatable only by Arcturus's own clients, creating a two-tiered security landscape in which corporate and state actors operate above the identity-verification systems imposed on ordinary citizens.
known_users: Arcturus Defense Solutions covert field operatives
High-tier freelance extraction and infiltration specialists
Corporate intelligence units with black-market procurement access
The GLMZ underground railroad (uses spoofed profiles to move protected individuals through checkpoints)
story_hooks: A Phantom Trace Spoofer recovered from a dead operative is still active and rotating through identities — one of those synthetic identities matches a real person who has been reported missing, suggesting the ghost-profile database may have been seeded with identities of real people who were then disappeared.

An Arcturus scanning node in a corporate district begins flagging Phantom Trace Spoofer ghost profiles in real time — someone has updated the detection layer, and every operative currently running a Spoofer in the district is suddenly at risk.

A player is offered a Spoofer at a suspiciously low price. Investigation reveals it has been hardware-modified to transmit a covert location beacon to an unknown third party alongside its spoofed identity broadcasts.

The GLMZ underground railroad's supply of Phantom Trace Spoofers has been cut off — the procurement leak inside Arcturus has gone silent, and the players are asked to find out why and restore the supply chain before a major movement of protected individuals is scheduled.
